name: EcoFlow RIVER 2 Pro
summary: A 768 Wh LiFePO4 power station with 800 W rated AC output for lights, communications and a carefully limited set of essential devices.
description: Use this as a candidate for a smaller set of essentials, then work from each device label and the expected outage length. Compare energy capacity and continuous output separately. A higher marketing boost number does not increase the normal AC budget or establish compatibility with a particular appliance.

specs.label: Rated AC output
specs.value: 800 W total, 120 V pure sine wave; 1600 W surge

specs.label: Other outputs
specs.value: USB-A: 12 W maximum; DC: 126 W maximum

pros: A separate solar input supports a later charging plan.
cons: The 800 W continuous limit constrains appliance selection.
Surge output is not continuous output.
